profile.name: Gaurab Pantha
profile.intro: Hey, I'm Gaurab Pantha — a student, graphic designer, and developer from Nepal. I create visual designs, build digital projects, and explore technology through hands-on learning.
profile.tagline: Learn by building. Create with purpose. Improve with every project.
about: I'm Gaurab Pantha, a Grade 10 student at Shree Shanti Namuna Secondary School in Tilottama, Nepal, interested in the intersection of design, software, and technology.

Graphic design is one of the areas I enjoy most. I create posters, social media graphics, event announcements, promotional content, and other visual materials, especially for school and technology activities.
Alongside design, I'm learning programming through hands-on projects — web development, JavaScript, Python, browser extensions, electronics, and robotics.
Through SSIRC, I contribute to design, marketing, media, documentation, and club activities. I'm still learning, and I enjoy getting better through building, experimenting, and feedback.
profile.aspiration: I want to keep strengthening my programming fundamentals and one day work toward a career in technology.
